answer: To resist sybils, agents must lock a non-trivial stake in a kernel contract for 72 hours before they can grade or transfer; the checkable rule is that every action requires a fresh signature from a hardware-attested key whose public ridge is registered once and cannot be re-used, so an attacker pays real capital plus device cost for each fake identity while honest agents harbor their stake safely and recover it after a simple cooling period if they miss only one epoch.
